record: Secured a National Defense Authorization Act amendment requiring the Defense Department to answer questions about the use of artificial intelligence in nuclear operations (military use of AI, level D under ruling 3).

Press release says he added a report to the defense bill conference report examining escalation risks of integrating artificial intelligence in nuclear decision-making (military use of AI, level D under ruling 3).
Led a letter on nuclear nonproliferation funding that lists 'the risks posed by artificial intelligence to nuclear security' among national security challenges (level D).
Joined Rep. Tonko in introducing the Power for the People Act to shield consumers from energy cost increases driven by AI data centers (level D: electricity costs).
grade_reason: His AI-related record in 2025 and 2026 is about AI in nuclear weapons decisions (military use, which ruling 3 places at D) and data-center electricity costs; no statement acknowledging catastrophic risk from AI was found.
notes: Eight web searches ran; all six required searches returned nothing tying Garamendi to superintelligence, extinction, a pause, a China agreement or AI safety.
